entryPoints: scripts only; no app import, UI integration, package hook, production endpoint or automatic migration
transaction: One native IndexedDB readwrite transaction serializes the monthly values, revision, operationId and undo receipt. Success is reported only after oncomplete and a final scope fence. Injected preflight finishes before any readwrite transaction.
preflightLimit: Tests inject synthetic auth/PDF preflight and session fences. Real getMe, PDF review and binding of reviewed intent are NOT integrated or proved here.
readModel: load returns a coherent transaction-loaded row, generation and ephemeral legacy snapshot. Every use must still pass generation/session/legacy guards. The diagnostic physicalRead helper is for test row inspection only and must never feed app UI. Snapshot guards do not claim that a cached revision is always the newest; production readers need invalidation/refresh and revision checks.
legacy: No automatic v1 import and no localStorage write fallback or dual-write. Monthly v1 and global manual INSS/IRRF/others must be captured together. Any present legacy difference is a conflict requiring review, never sum/merge. Hash comparison detects current differences; it does not provide an audit history of transient legacy edits.
precedenceToShow: For each field show the exact current source: valid reviewed monthly value first; otherwise explicitly configured global manual value as a visible fallback; otherwise unknown. Keep missing distinct from zero. Never erase global values, copy them into confirmed monthly data or hide their precedence.
generation: The harness explicitly supplies a synthetic marker. There is no production initialization API. Removed markers invalidate scoped use; reinitialization must use a new generation and may not silently adopt stale records. Marker lifecycle and initialization require specific review before activation.
resetCoverageRequired: Safe Shell/recovery HTML emitted by server.mjs and its materializers
auth expiry, replacement and cross-tab invalidation
resetTestLimit: The prototype simulates marker removal and auth-only removal in two tabs. It does not execute or prove the actual production reset pages/generators. All those paths remain unchanged.
deletionLimit: Immediate guarded-use invalidation is logical, not physical deletion. Records can remain in IndexedDB pending explicit cleanup. Cleanup commits deletion of matching old-generation logical rows only; neither that commit nor marker removal proves secure physical byte erasure from browser storage or media.
undo: Only same generation, expected revision, operationId and matching applied fields; restores only the prior selected values/absence in a new transaction. A later edit, wrong operation or generation must fail.
activationBlockers: review actual reader lifecycle and refresh behavior
cover all real reset pages/generators and auth transitions
review marker initialization, stale records and cleanup interruption
validate domain/provenance/document preflight and exact binding of reviewed selection
exercise browser storage unavailable/quota/blocked upgrades and interrupted tab recovery
independent architecture review of this prototype
excluded: No encryption scheme, new service, production data, payment settlement changes, app activation or financial migration.
